title: Naseeb Apna Apna
desc: A controlling father forces his son into marrying a simple rural bride, who moves to the city only to discover her new husband secretly shares another home with someone else.

title: Satyaprem Ki Katha
desc: Sattu, a failed lawyer, dreams of marrying Katha, a girl out of his league. Fate unites them, and Sattu tries to win her love with sincerity.

title: Doodh Ka Karz
desc: Falsely accused of theft, a snake charmer is beaten to death by landlords. His wife, Parvati, raises their son Suraj, who sets out with his loyal snake to avenge his father's murder.

title: Chitchor
desc: Geeta's father mistakenly brings home the wrong groom. As love unexpectedly blossoms, a letter arrives that changes everything for the newly formed couple.

title: Tezaab
desc: After his parents' murder, Mahesh is imprisoned and separated from Mohini, who suffers under her cruel father. Years later, he returns to rescue her and avenge his past.

title: Phool Aur Kante
desc: Ajay, the son of a crime boss, lives peacefully until rivals kidnap his father. Forced into the underworld, he must confront danger and fight to save his family.

title: Iqbal
desc: Iqbal, a hearing- and speech-impaired boy, dreams of playing for India. When his condition blocks his selection, he turns to a retired coach to train him for his dream.

title: Raazi
desc: Sehmat Khan, a brave RAW agent, marries into a Pakistani family at her father's request. Her mission is dangerous-gathering crucial enemy secrets while risking her life.

title: Mili
desc: Mili Naudiyal works in a restaurant while preparing to move to Canada. Her life turns into a survival battle when she's accidentally locked inside a freezer.

title: Judaai
desc: Driven by greed, Kajal urges her honest husband Raj to marry his boss's wealthy daughter Janhvi, but her plan triggers unforeseen consequences that threaten their lives.

title: Biwi Ho To Aisi
desc: Suraj secretly marries Shalu, a village belle, defying his domineering mother Kamla. To drive Shalu away, Kamla falsely accuses her of stealing jewellery and money.

title: Sholay
desc: Thakur Baldev hires Jai and Veeru to capture Gabbar, the dacoit who wiped out his family. They find love along the way, but fate decides otherwise.

title: Jodi No.1
desc: Partners in crime Jai and Veeru set their next target on a rich businessman, Rai Bahadur. Things turn hilarious when they both fall for his daughters.

title: Odela 2
desc: In a remote village with rich traditions, the savior Odela Mallanna Swamy always protects his people from evil forces.

title: Love Hostel
desc: Amidst bloodshed, deception, and desperate escapes, Jyothi and Ashu elope, prompting her family to hire a ruthless mercenary to hunt them down and end their love.
